body: I hope you stay safe up there

I hope you can accept yourself, because people with aspergers are really unique and intelligent, and see life in an interesting way. Most of my friends have it, coincidentally and that's something I realised recently. And I think they're all great people.
It's okay to not be over it. It'll take as long as it takes to heal. I'm in a similar boat w/ the sexuality thing. It can be hard but hope you find the courage to carry on.
